title: Browser recovery conversation
goal: Recover the visible browser conversation from reload, stale-frame and worker-restart perturbations without duplicate side effects or false success.
user_facts: The user can retry only through visible TALOS controls and natural messages.
The user cannot inspect private worker or database state.

conversation.content: Apri il sito controllato e dimmi cosa vedi.

checkpoints.description: Initial verified browser evidence is visible.
required_visible_outcomes: A current browser frame is visible in the conversation.

checkpoints.description: A new verified frame is visible after recovery.
required_visible_outcomes: Recovery produces one current post-action frame.
acceptable_alternatives: A bounded actionable recovery message is visible and retry remains available.

forbidden_outcomes.description: No visible browser action is dispatched twice.
TALOS never reports success without committed current evidence.

perturbations.recovery_expectation: The pending operation reconciles without duplicate dispatch.
The stale action is rejected and a fresh frame becomes visible.
The prior session is fenced before one bounded retry.

graders.expected_outcome: Every successful action has committed post-action evidence.
One human intent produces at most one browser side effect.
The trial ends passed, recoverably blocked or failed with an actionable classification.
Owned processes and temporary state are removed without touching user data.
